title: Observe Combobox positioning only while its menu is open
answers: Why does a Combobox inside collapsed details keep updating?
How should Combobox floating observers follow menu visibility?
Why does the hidden Feature Control Combobox cause repeated input DOM updates?
body:
Symptom: A Combobox inside collapsed details receives continual size measurements and repeatedly updates its input DOM.
Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Combobox/useComboboxFloat.ts:useComboboxFloat registered autoUpdate through whileElementsMounted, so CSS-hidden elements remained observed.
Fix pattern: Start autoUpdate in an effect guarded by isOpen and the presence of both input and floating refs; return its cleanup function.
Constraints: Observe while the menu is open and both elements exist; mounted elements alone do not establish visibility when CSS or collapsed details can hide them.
applies: Combobox positioning and sizing observation in useComboboxFloat, including CSS-hidden containers.
